create_EvalHook: create an EvalHook instance with a DataLoader to evaluate the model every N epochs during training
create_DistEvalHook: create a DistEvalHook for distributed multi-GPU evaluation with configurable tmpdir and gpu_collect options
run_EvalHook_after_train_epoch: run the EvalHook after_train_epoch method to trigger single GPU model evaluation on the dataloader
run_DistEvalHook_after_train_epoch: run the DistEvalHook after_train_epoch method to trigger multi-GPU model evaluation across processes
review_EvalHook_init_rule: review the EvalHook _init_rule method to understand how greater and less comparison rules are inferred
